reviews.text: I am grateful for the kind and thorough examination. At the end of the examination, the doctor said, "She's so cute, I'm sorry," which showed that he loves animals.

Today I came to see my elderly cat (18 years old) for diarrhea and nausea. He gave me a thorough explanation of the cause and what to do, and spoke to the cat kindly during the examination, which gave me a sense of security.
